# Cncf Swisscom Kubernetes Service Reviewer

Review Swisscom Kubernetes Service using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Hosted category. Kubernetes Service is a managed Kubernetes offering in Swisscom’s Private Cloud, based on open-source technology and CNCF tools.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
